html Production Control (all genders)Garching / Full-time / Permanent employee About us

Blackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.

More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.

Production Control (all genders)
Garching / Full-time / Permanent employee YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

THE WHY
To end COPV failure in spaceflight. As we grow, production becomes more complex — with multiple teams, machines, technologies, and locations. Your mission is to keep all these moving parts aligned and ensure that our production output is achieved every day.

THE WHAT
You are the daily connection between planning and execution. You coordinate production teams, translate capacity and production needs into realistic plans, and react quickly when priorities, capacities, or timelines change.

You ensure:

- Production plans reflect real machine and personnel capacity
- Production targets are achieved through effective daily coordination
- Changes and disruptions are addressed with appropriate countermeasures
- Production bottlenecks are identified early and resolved together with the relevant teams
- Production, logistics, engineering, quality, and management stay aligned

You don't just plan production. You make the plan become reality.

Coordinate daily production: Align multiple manufacturing teams and ensure that production targets are achieved. → High Performance: Keep the shop floor moving.

Build realistic production plans: Translate available machine and personnel capacity into achievable plans and identify upcoming capacity increases early. → Accountability: Plan realistically. Deliver reliably.

React to changes: Identify deviations, delays, and capacity constraints and develop appropriate countermeasures together with the relevant teams. →Candor: Surface problems early and act on them.

Resolve bottlenecks: Work closely with Logistics to systematically identify and eliminate supply and material bottlenecks. → Togetherness: Production succeeds when teams work as one.

Improve production performance: Work closely with Process Engineering to identify weaknesses through recurring quality issues and increased reject rates and drive improvements. → Playfulness: Stay curious. Find better ways to work.

YOUR PROFILE

- Experience in production planning, production control, manufacturing, operations, or a comparable environment
- Strong understanding of how individual production steps influence the overall production output
- Experience coordinating multiple teams or production activities on the shop floor
- Strong cross-functional communication skills and the ability to align Production, Planning, Engineering, Quality, Logistics, PJM, and Management
- Structured, solution-oriented, and able to remain effective when priorities and conditions change
- Comfortable working as the central interface between planning and execution
- Strong ownership and the ability to identify problems and drive solutions independently
- German (C1 minimum) and English (B2 minimum)
- Willingness to work 95% on-site across our Garching and Taufkirchen locations

Nice to have:

- Experience in aerospace, automotive, or another complex manufacturing environment.
- Basic understanding of metal processing and/or fiber composite manufacturing.
- Experience with production planning or project management.
- Experience working in environments with multiple manufacturing technologies or facilities.

WHAT WE OFFER

- High level of autonomy & real impact: Be part of shaping our high-tech production landscape
- Flexible working hours & remote work options based on mutual agreement
- Startup mindset meets aerospace innovation: Flat hierarchies, fast decisions, and space for your ideas
- Choose your own benefit: Germany ticket, Egym Wellpass, or a tax-free Give Card
- Healthy & social lunch culture: Enjoy fresh meals during shared lunch breaks
- Stunning views: Wind down on our rooftop terrace with breathtaking views of the Alps
- Growth opportunities: Work on exciting projects and learn from inspiring people
- We live our team culture: From tech talks to team events and after-work gatherings – we celebrate success together

Please refer to reference number YF-50269 for your application.

Senior Industrialization Engineer – Space Manufacturing (all genders)
Garching, Taufkirchen / Full-time / Permanent employee YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

THE WHY

To end COPV failure in spaceflight.

Blackwave manufactures carbon structural components for rockets, and satellites – with the ambition to make space access as reliable and scalable as automotive production. That demands a manufacturing operation that grows with us: process-stable, reproducible, and ramp-up-proof. That's where you come in.

THE WHAT

Be the process mastermind of our manufacturing operation.

At Blackwave, you coordinate production engineering across all teams, set priorities on open issues, and drive our manufacturing processes toward serial production standards – scalable, resilient, and ready for every ramp-up.

Drive & Improve Processes

Systematically analyze production processes for scalability and robustness – then actively raise the bar.

Own and maintain a structured, always-current list of open points across all production steps.

Set the Standards

Implement 5S standards at workstations and in material handling – consistently and sustainably.

Push fixture and tooling improvements from concept through manufacturing, implementation, and verification.

Machine Performance

Coordinate stakeholders and engineers when scoping new machines, ensuring performance reliably meets requirements.

YOUR PROFILE

- Space-to-Automotive Mindset: you understand the sensitivity of the space industry and translate it into robust, scalable manufacturing processes
- Lean & CI Methods: proven experience with Kaizen, SMED, 5S, and related tools to improve throughput, reduce waste, and drive continuous improvement
- Risk Management: identify production risks early, develop mitigation plans, and support successful production ramp-ups
- Root Cause Mastery: experienced in structured problem-solving methods such as 5 Whys, Ishikawa, and FMEA, turning production issues into sustainable corrective actions
- Cross-functional Communicator: translate shopfloor realities into clear inputs for Planning, Engineering, QA, and Management while keeping stakeholders aligned
- Shopfloor Driven: enjoy working hands-on with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering, and operators to solve problems where they occur
- Thrives in Complexity: comfortable operating in fast-changing environments, balancing immediate production needs with long-term process improvements
- Change Agent: support the introduction of new technologies, equipment, and processes while helping teams adapt and grow
- Languages: Fluent German and English (C1 level) essential
- Location: Regular on-site presence required across our Garching and Taufkirchen locations

WHAT WE OFFER

- Ownership & creative freedom – you actively shape how we bring aerospace components to serial production
- Flexible hours & mobile working – work-life balance is a real commitment, not a talking point
- Start-up spirit meets aerospace – flat hierarchies, fast decisions, genuine room for initiative
- Personalized benefits – choose between Germany Ticket, Egym Wellpass, or a tax-free Givve Card
- Fresh food daily – shared lunches with healthy, varied dishes

Our group at the University Hospital Erlangen is recruiting a highly motivated PhD candidate.

The project “P13 - Modulation of CRC development and progression by GPR15L-dependent effects on lymphocyte infiltration and the intestinal microbiota” is part of the Collaborative Research Centre TRR 417 “Cellular Communication in the Stroma of Colorectal Cancer: From Pathophysiology to Clinical Translation”, a major German research consortium (Frankfurt - Freiburg - Erlangen). The PhD candidate will investigate the impact of the endogenous peptide GPR15L on the tumor microenvironment in colorectal cancer (in particular with regard to T cell recruitment and with regard to effects on the intestinal microbiome) using state-of-the art in vivo and in vitro models along with human samples.

To this end, the candidate will be trained in the following techniques:

Multi-color flow cytometry
Advanced mouse genetics
State-of-the-art mouse models of colorectal cancer
Analysis of omics data
Organoid culture systems
Standard molecular biology methods
Your Profile:

Completed Master's degree (or equivalent) in immunology, molecular biology, molecular medicine or related disciplines
Strong interest in translational research
Excellent written and spoken English
Structured working style
Team-oriented mindset (you will work in a working group with more than 15 colleagues and collaborate with several groups associated to the TRR417 consortium)
Knowledge of basic molecular biology techniques such as IHC, PCR, histology, cell culture or flow cytometry
Experience in working with mice (Felasa B) and basic knowledge of bioinformatics is advantageous
Possible starting date: 01.01.2027

jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Shape the future of drug discovery through scientific innovation and collaboration.
Join a highly innovative environment where cutting-edge science, advanced technologies, and multidisciplinary teamwork come together to address some of the most challenging questions in pharmaceutical research. This is a unique opportunity to contribute your expertise, influence scientific strategies, foster collaboration across global teams, and help drive breakthroughs that have the potential to improve patients' lives worldwide.
Ready to make a lasting impact? Apply now and be part of our journey to transform the future of healthcare.
Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you will identify, develop, validate, and advance state-of-the-art computational methods in molecular AI/ML, cheminformatics, and structure-based drug design.
- You will drive the application of these innovative computational approaches to support the discovery and optimization of novel lead compounds.
- Furthermore, you will partner closely with medicinal chemists, computational scientists, and multidisciplinary project teams to understand scientific needs and priorities.
- You will communicate model outputs and limitations effectively and translate computational insights into actionable recommendations.
- Moreover, you will collaborate with software engineers, data scientists, and other partners to develop and deploy scalable computational workflows for molecular design, synthesis planning, and decision support, integrating them into our digital ecosystem.
- Finally, you will mentor postdoctoral researchers and scientists, and establish, lead, and supervise internal and external scientific collaborations.

Requirements

- PhD in Computer Science, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline
- Several years of experience applying computational approaches to drug discovery within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or related life sciences industry
- Strong expertise in machine learning, artificial intelligence, and data science methodologies to chemical data
- Demonstrated knowledge in one or more of the following areas: molecular property prediction, foundation models for molecular data, generative molecular design, reaction prediction, structure-based modeling, or agentic AI for scientific discovery
- Proven proficiency in Python-based scientific computing, machine learning frameworks, and cheminformatics tools such as RDKit
- Experience with collaborative software engineering best practices, including version control, testing, and CI/CD workflows
- Creative, collaborative, and proactive mindset, with excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills and a demonstrated ability to influence and work effectively across multidisciplinary teams

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.
Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
WHY BOEHRINGER INGELHEIM?
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.
Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.
Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.
Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com

Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until "October 23rd, 2026". We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand. Applications up to "23.10.2026" are guaranteed to be considered.
Step 2: Virtual meeting during end October

Job description

In order to support Electrification Technologies department, Airbus Defence and Space is offering an

Internship / Master Thesis: Advanced Power Electronics & Hardware Design (d/f/m)

Are you looking for an internship or a master thesis and want to get to know the work of a Power Electronics Researcher (d/f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Electrification Technologies department as an intern (d/f/m)!

- Location: Taufkirchen/Ottobrunn
- Start: December 2026
- Duration: 5-6 months

Are you passionate about power electronics and eager to work on next-generation hardware designs? We offer a flexible and exciting opportunity – whether you are looking for an Internship or a Master Thesis. Join our team to design, simulate, and build innovative power electronic converter systems.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Research & Exploration: Investigate modern semiconductor devices (e.g., SiC, GaN)
and innovative converter topologies suited for high-performance applications.
- Simulation & Modeling: Use PLECS and LTSpice to model converter topologies,
analyze circuit behavior, and validate design concepts prior to prototyping.
- Hardware Design: Design and develop PCBs for power electronic prototypes, focusing on optimized layout for fast switching and low parasitic inductance.
- Prototyping & Testing: Assembly, testing, and initial operation of power electronic
circuits in the laboratory, verifying simulation results with real-world measurements.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student within Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering or a similar field of studies.
- A solid understanding of basic power electronics components and inverter topologies.
- Proven experience in PCB design and layout (preferably in KiCAD). This is essential for the practical aspects of the work.
- Proficiency and enthusiasm for circuit simulation using tools like PLECS and LTSpice, geared towards research and rapid prototyping.
- A proactive, curious, and analytical approach to problem-solving.
- Fluent communication skills in English and German.

jobs.description:
Full- or part-time | temporary (24 months) | Klinik und Poliklinik für RadioOnkologie und Strahlentherapie

The Department of Radiation Oncology at TUM University hospital is recruiting a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join our Radiation Biology Research Group.

Our research focuses on translating novel radiotherapy concepts from experimental models toward clinical application, with a particular emphasis on spatially fractionated radiotherapy (SFRT). We aim to understand the biological mechanisms underlying tumor response and normal-tissue tolerance and to establish the preclinical evidence required for future clinical trials.

The position offers the opportunity to work at the interface of radiobiology, radiation oncology, and medical physics within an interdisciplinary translational research environment.

Your responsibilities:

- Irradiation and dosimetry of mouse cohorts using MBRT and conventional radiation, across single- vs. multi-fraction regimens
- Longitudinal neurobehavioral testing 
- Histological and immunohistochemical analysis of neuroinflammation, vascular, and structural brain changes
- Neurotransmitter profiling and biomarker analysis 
- Statistical and integrative analysis of dose-response and biomarker data to define normal-brain tolerance thresholds
- Close collaboration with scientists and clinicians from radiation oncology, medical physics, and radiobiology, and translation of findings into clinically relevant concepts for future MBRT trials

Your profile:

- We are looking for a highly motivated scientist with a strong interest in experimental and translational radiation oncology and radiobiology 
- A doctoral degree in biology, biomedical sciences, veterinary medicine, or a related field is required 
- Experience with preclinical in vivo models and animal experimentation is desirable 
- Expertise in tumor cell culture, histology, immunohistochemistry, or molecular biology would be an advantage 
- A background in radiation biology and radiation-induced normal-tissue effects would be advantageous 
- The ability to independently plan, conduct, analyze, and document experimental studies is expected 
- A strong interest in interdisciplinary and translational research at the interface of radiation oncology, medical physics, and biology is essential 
- Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in an interdisciplinary research environment are required 
- Flexibility and mobility to make full use of the scientific opportunities and research infrastructure available across TUM sites (TUM University Hospital Rechts der Isar and the Garching Research Campus) 
- Good written and spoken English skills are essential 

We offer you:

- EGYM well pass, corporate benefits and discounts (e.g. Käfer), cafeteria, sports and cultural offers
- Working in the heart of Munich at Max-Weber-Platz with very good accessibility by public transport such as the subway, S-Bahn or tram 
- Company pension plan through the Federal and State Pension Institute (VBL) 
- Self-realization through a varied and technically demanding job with interdisciplinary cooperation between various departments of the TUM Klinikum

We look forward to meeting you!

Kontakt: Frau Daniela Schilling | 089 / 4140 –9403 | Klinik und Poliklinik für RadioOnkologie und Strahlentherapie

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

The Coating Engineer is part of a team of Mechanical and Materials Engineers within the Turbine Design Department. The purpose of this team is to support the development of new turbine components during design and process qualification and to disposition manufacturing non conformances of existing hardware. Also, an important aspect of this position will be to help implement and industrialize new coating technologies from technological development into the manufacturing environment in collaboration with internal and external technology development, manufacturing and sourcing organizations. This position is a central engineering interface between turbine design and turbine manufacturing and sourcing organizations. You are working with both departments and internal and external vendors to develop manufacturable designs during component development.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Support of coating technology industrialization within the coating supply base
* Execution and support of coating qualification activities for turbine hot gas path components
* Evaluation of in‑process manufacturing data with regard to design intent
* Assurance of compliance with design‑for‑manufacturing principles for new components
* Preparation and revision of product definitions as well as design‑for‑manufacturing philosophies
* Support of production issue resolution and implementation of quality and cost improvement measures

What You Bring

* University degree in materials engineering, process engineering, mechanical engineering, or a comparable qualification
* Longstanding years of professional experience in the field of high‑temperature coatings and/or materials engineering
* In‑depth knowledge of thermal spray processes and coating properties
* Prior knowledge of gas turbine hot gas path components, including materials and coating processes
* Very good written and spoken German and English language skills as a prerequisite

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.  

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical 

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

Amalienbadstraße 41b, 76227 Karlsruhe, Germany Full-time Company:
Tipico Technology Services GmbH We are Tipico, Germany's leading
sports betting provider and one of the most dynamic tech companies in
the industry, part of Banijay Gaming - a European champion in sports
betting and online gaming. We approach every challenge like a
Championship match, with a mission to excite the arena and elevate the
betting experience for every customer. Our culture is energetic and
ambitious—we play as a team to win high, leave an impact, and commit
to excellence. Fueled by our passion for the perfect product, we use
the newest tech stack to get better every single day. At Tipico, we
believe in owning our game. Are you ready to step onto the pitch,
bring your best self, and become a champion? Then show us your game
face – because we’re looking for a Research Specialist Customer
Experience - German Speaking (m/f/x) to join the team! Job Description
As a Research Specialist Customer Experience - German Speaking
(m/f/x), you will play a key role in uncovering insights that shape
our customer experience, product decisions, and business strategies.
You will design, execute, and analyze qualitative and quantitative
customer experience research to understand customer behaviors,
motivations, and pain points, and translate data into clear,
actionable recommendations. Working closely with the Customer
Experience, Product, Data, and Marketing teams, you’ll connect
research findings with operational and behavioral data to build a
holistic view of the customer journey and drive measurable
improvements in KPIs. Your playing field: Designing and conducting
customer experience research projects across qualitative and
quantitative methodologies — including surveys, usability tests, and
interviews. Acting as a voice of the customer, ensuring their needs,
challenges, and feedback are represented in strategic and operational
decisions. Analyzing customer feedback and operational data to
identify key drivers of satisfaction, loyalty, and engagement.
Integrating research insights with FullStory to create a 360°
understanding of customer behavior. Developing and presenting clear,
data-driven reports and dashboards to stakeholders, highlighting key
findings, trends, and actionable recommendations. Collaborating with
the Product, CX, and Data teams to prioritize improvements based on
customer impact and business outcomes. Partnering with third-party
research agencies when needed to ensure high-quality project execution
and robust methodologies. Building and maintaining analytical models
that link customer sentiment, product usage, and operational
performance. Qualifications Which skills should you bring to the
pitch: Research Expertise. Strong command of both qualitative

jobs.occupation: Product Security Senior Specialist (f/m/d) - Sovereign Cloud (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Apply Now
Product Security Senior Specialist (f/m/d) - Sovereign Cloud

Date: 09/23/2026
Company: SAP

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

SAP LeanIX is expanding into Sovereign Cloud environments - a strategic initiative that will make our product available to customers in regulated industries and the public sector who operate under strict data residency, security, and compliance requirements.

We are starting with NS2 in the United States, with the ambition to extend to further sovereign and government cloud environments globally over time.
This is a greenfield effort that spans engineering, product, and compliance, and it includes building the infrastructure, processes, and capabilities to meet the highest standards of data sovereignty while delivering the full power of SAP LeanIX to an entirely new category of customers.

The SAP LeanIX Security, Compliance and Governance team is looking for a motivated  Product Security Senior Specialist to engage in activities related to the SAP LeanIX Information Security Management System, and drive implementation and design of compliance controls for the SAP LeanIX Enterprise Architecture portfolio. This position puts particular focus on Sovereign Cloud / Cloud in Country certifications such as FedRAMP or equivalent national standards, and on control ownership for selected cross-engineering controls.

What You'll Do:

- 
Work together with colleagues in development, governance and security functions.

- 
Organize workshops and trainings for control owners and security champions to better understand requirements and best practices.

- 
Assist in compliance certification efforts for Sovereign Cloud and Cloud in Country environments for LeanIX Enterprise Architecture portfolio, including frameworks like FedRAMP, or equivalent national standards.

- 
Translate complex regulatory and government compliance requirements into actionable technical tasks and policy updates.

- 
Stay current with global and local regulations related to data sovereignty, privacy, and government cloud security to ensure proactive compliance.

- 
Collaborate with certification bodies and internal certification intermediaries.

- 
Engage as control owner for selected cross-engineering controls that are owned by the LeanIX Security, Compliance and Governance unit.

- 
Oversee the resolution of Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) items.

- 
Coordinate certification projects and small networks of functional colleagues for successfully obtaining certifications.

- 
Engage in Audit sessions together with internal and external auditors.

What You Bring:

- 
Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Information Security or related Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) disciplines.

- 
7+ years in Information Security, with at least 4 years focus on GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance), IT Audit, or a similar compliance-related role.

- 
Proven experience leading certification or attestation projects for at least one major information security framework (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, C5).

- 
Deep understanding of GRC assessment methodologies, control design, and the audit lifecycle.

- 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate complex technical and compliance concepts to diverse audiences (from engineers to executives).

- 
Experience with Jira.

- 
You’re an open-minded team player.

- 
Fluent spoken and written English communication skills.

Beneficial skills:

- 
Experience in BCM / DR topics

- 
Direct, hands-on experience with government-specific cloud compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP (US), IRAP (Australia), or similar national programs.

- 
Experience with NIST standards, particularly the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF) and controls defined in NIST SP 800-53.

- 
Industry recognized professional certification such as CISSP, CISA, Lead Auditor or SANS

- 
Familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automating compliance tasks and evidence gathering

- 
Experience with using AI tools such as Claude.

- 
Spoken and written German communication skills

Meet your team:

The Information Security team is responsible for managing the security of SAP LeanIX enterprise architecture solution in coordination with Product and Engineering organization as well as SAP’s central security team.

Taking a risk-based approach to security, compliance and governance, we support thousands of colleagues and customers within and outside of SAP LeanIX. We team up with others in SAP (e.g., SAP Global Security and Cloud Compliance, SAP DPP, SAP BTP) to identify, implement, and operate technically effective and trade-off efficient security, compliance and governance solutions.

Skills included: Agentic AI Day-to-Day Practice, AI Adoption Capability, AI Output Quality Assurance, Context Engineering, AI-Assisted Automation and Prototyping, Learning Agility, Collaboration, Complex Problem Solving, Creative Thinking, Effective Communication, Information security management, cloud security, application security, security engineering, AI-Assisted engineering.

​

Bring out your best
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.
